title: OpenAI Foundation gave us $40M to improve cancer vaccines
subtitle: We're starting the Initiative for Generative Immunotherapy at UNC to release unusually rich data from tumors and the T cells that recognize them
author: Alex Rubinsteyn
excerpt: We love personalized cancer vaccines. They are an elegantly general, wonderfully sci-fi approach to treating cancer by directing a patient’s immune system to pay attention to the oddities displayed on cancer cells.
